title: US Universities Fall 2027 Early Action / Early Decision
description: MIT, Stanford, Harvard, Princeton, Caltech Early Action / Early Decision round.
recommendedActions: Finalize Common App / Coalition App essays
Request 3 Letters of Recommendation (LORs) from professors/mentors
Send official TOEFL/IELTS and GRE score reports

title: UK Oxford & Cambridge (Oxbridge) & Medicine Deadline
description: UCAS application deadline for Oxford, Cambridge, and all UK Medicine/Dentistry courses for 2027 entry.
recommendedActions: Polish UCAS Personal Statement (4,000 characters)
Register for admissions tests (e.g., UCAT, MAT, STEP, LNAT)
Ensure academic reference is uploaded by school referee

title: German Universities Summer 2027 Intake
description: Uni-Assist and direct portal application deadline for TUM, LMU Munich, RWTH Aachen Summer semester.
recommendedActions: Get APS Certificate (India / China / Vietnam candidates)
Order certified copies of Bachelor's degree and transcripts
Verify course module description (Modulhandbuch) compatibility

title: German Universities Winter 2026/2027 (Main Intake)
description: Main application window for all public universities in Germany for the Winter semester starting October 2026.
recommendedActions: Submit Uni-Assist VPD requests at least 6 weeks in advance
Open Blocked Account (Expatrio / Coracle / Fintiba) with €11,208
Book German student visa appointment at VFS / Embassy

title: Chevening Scholarships 2027/2028 Cycle
description: Fully funded UK government scholarship covering master's tuition, stipend, and airfare.
recommendedActions: Draft 4 Chevening leadership and networking essays (500 words each)
Select 3 eligible master's degree courses at UK universities
Secure two strong professional/academic referees

title: DAAD EPOS Postgraduate Scholarship Deadline
description: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses full funding for developing nation scholars.
recommendedActions: Gather 2 years of verifiable professional work experience proof
Draft Europass format CV and DAAD motivation letter
Apply directly to participating German university course coordinators

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM) Scholarship Round
description: Full EU funding covering tuition and €1,400/month stipend across 2+ EU countries.
recommendedActions: Select up to 3 Erasmus Mundus master's consortia from the EMJM catalogue
Tailor SOP to the mobility track of the chosen consortium
Ensure proof of residence and english proficiency test are ready

title: SINGA Singapore PhD Award (August 2027 Intake)
description: Full PhD scholarship at NUS, NTU, SUTD with S$2,200-S$2,700/mo stipend and travel allowance.
recommendedActions: Identify prospective PhD supervisors from A*STAR, NUS, or NTU faculty
Prepare research proposal / academic interests statement
Upload 2 academic referee letters
